prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. A station records rainfall for 12 consecutive weeks and wants the direction and turning points to be clear. Enter the most suitable code only.

content.text: Decide whether the readings form a sequence in time or a set of separate groups.
The rainfall values run in week order, and the reader wants to follow the rises, falls and turning points. Ask which display shows one value changing from one week to the next.
A line graph joins the 12 weekly readings in order, so the direction and turning points are clear. A table gives the exact values, but readers would have to work out the rises and falls themselves.
